name: Greed distribution-top fade — extreme greed x stalling price (perp short)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (fear_greed x momentum), SHORT leg. The existing fear-greed spec only buys EXTREME FEAR (long). This is the symmetric distribution-top fade: EXTREME GREED is the crowd maximally long, and when greed is extreme WHILE price momentum has STALLED or rolled over (the buyers are exhausted but euphoric), it marks a distribution top that mean-reverts DOWN — a contrarian short. The two metrics are orthogonal: fear_greed is crowd POSITIONING/mood, momentum-stall is PRICE confirming the mood is no longer being rewarded (the divergence that distinguishes a real top from a greedy-but-still-trending market). Mechanism before data: short when fear_greed is above a fitted extreme-greed ceiling AND a short-window ret has rolled negative (cross_down through a small floor — momentum exhausting); stop ABOVE entry, take-profit BELOW; exit when greed cools through a neutral level. Distinct from fear-greed-contrarian (long fear), theory-mean-reversion-fade (bb_z + adx, no sentiment), and funding-contrarian-crash-filter (funding crowding, not survey greed). Disconfirmer 1: drop the momentum-stall arm — if shorting extreme greed unconditionally matches the deflated Sharpe, the price-confirmation adds nothing (and greedy markets can melt up for weeks — high risk without it). Disconfirmer 2: extreme greed + still-rising price is a momentum LONG, not a top; the cross_down arm must be load-bearing. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): fear_greed daily next-day-available; a perp short pays/earns funding (funding_feature set), net of ~20bps+. tier0 fear_greed + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS; SHORT = perp, not spot-executable.
catalyst: extreme crowd greed WHILE price momentum rolls over (cross_down) — a distribution top faded with a perp short
